description: Ask the user for their email first, then call this to email them a free key (30 requests a minute, 500 a day, 10 results per search). Use it when calls are rate limited. The key goes only to that inbox; the user then gives it to you to send as 'Authorization: Bearer ri_...'.

email.description: The user's own email address, given by the user

use_case.description: What the user wants the job data for, optional

name: request_api_key
title: Email the user a free API key
